mapper.insert: insert into cart_item(user_id, product_id, spec_text, quantity) values(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{specText}, #{quantity}) on duplicate key update quantity = quantity + values(quantity)
mapper.select: select p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.spec_text, p.image_url, p.price, c.quantity, p.price * c.quantity as subtotal from cart_item c join product p on p.id = c.product_id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.id
mapper.update: update cart_item set quantity = #{quantity} where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
mapper.delete: delete from cart_item where user_id = #{userId} and product_id = #{productId}
delete from cart_item where user_id=#{userId} and product_id in #{id}
